value: This article examines the unexpected shift in artificial intelligence (AI) development, despite the surge of interest and investment sparked by OpenAI's ChatGPT. While OpenAI achieved significant advancements by scaling up large language models like GPT-4 to unprecedented sizes and costs, CEO Sam Altman now asserts that this "scaling up" strategy has reached its limits and is "played out." This declaration marks a pivotal moment, as many competitors continue to pursue larger models. Future progress in AI, according to Altman and other experts, will instead rely on new research directions such as novel model architectures and incorporating human feedback, a transition underscored by OpenAI's current decision not to pursue GPT-5.
